title: Linux administration for DevOps in the AI era
levels: L0 (never done it) to L3+ (runs it in production)
tagline: Run Linux the way the gurus taught it, run the Linux underneath AI systems old and new, and let open-source AI help you without letting it near your keys.
how_it_teaches: Predict before you see. Every command output and every number is a question first, an answer second.
Fix it like rustlings. Broken config files sit in workspace/; you fix them in your own editor and the checks re-run on every save.
Manual before agent. You fix it by hand before an agent is allowed to touch it.
Real runs count. Lab rounds clear only when the game finds the lab's result files on disk.
Spaced review. Anything you miss comes back tomorrow, then in three days, a week, three weeks.
Explain your diff. No agent task ends without a rollback and a 'not verified' list.
A delayed quiz, two days later, because the gap between AI-assisted and manual learners shows up on retention.

cgroup: stat -fc %T /sys/fs/cgroup 2>/dev/null || echo 'no /sys/fs/cgroup here (this machine is not Linux)'
ollama: ss -ltnp 2>/dev/null | grep 11434 || lsof -nP -iTCP:11434 -sTCP:LISTEN 2>/dev/null || echo 'nothing listening on 11434'
listening: ss -ltn 2>/dev/null | head -15 || netstat -an 2>/dev/null | grep -i listen | head -15
kind: kind get clusters 2>/dev/null || echo 'kind not installed'
bwrap: command -v bwrap >/dev/null && echo 'bwrap present' || echo 'bwrap missing'
pressure: cat /proc/pressure/cpu /proc/pressure/memory /proc/pressure/io 2>/dev/null || echo 'no PSI here (kernel too old, or not Linux)'
sshd_kex: ssh -Q kex 2>/dev/null | head -5 || echo 'ssh client not found'
deleted_open: command -v lsof >/dev/null && (lsof +L1 2>/dev/null | head -12; true) || echo 'lsof not installed'
nvidia: nvidia-smi --query-gpu=name,driver_version,memory.total --format=csv,noheader 2>/dev/null || echo 'no NVIDIA driver on this machine'
assisted: cd '{root}' && git log --format=%B -n 50 2>/dev/null | grep -c '^Assisted-by: LLM' || true

delayed_quiz.q: Name Brendan Gregg's first five commands of the 60-second checklist, in order, and what each one is for.
delayed_quiz.a: uptime (load averages, trend), dmesg | tail (OOM kills, I/O and driver errors), vmstat 1 (run queue, memory, swap, CPU split), mpstat -P ALL 1 (per-CPU imbalance), pidstat 1 (which process uses the CPU).

delayed_quiz.q: df says the root filesystem is 100% full but du adds up to far less. What is the most likely cause and which command proves it?
delayed_quiz.a: A deleted file still held open by a running process, often a log. lsof +L1 lists it; restart the process (or truncate through /proc/<pid>/fd/<n>) to free the space.

delayed_quiz.q: Where do you change a packaged unit's settings so the next package upgrade does not overwrite them, and how do you see the result?
delayed_quiz.a: A drop-in under /etc/systemd/system/<unit>.d/override.conf, usually with systemctl edit <unit>; systemctl cat <unit> shows the merged unit, then daemon-reload and restart.

delayed_quiz.q: nvidia-smi says CUDA Version 12.4 and nvcc says 11.8. Is that a problem? Why?
delayed_quiz.a: No. nvidia-smi prints the newest CUDA version the installed driver supports; nvcc prints the toolkit that is installed. A toolkit at or below the driver's supported version works.

delayed_quiz.q: In one sentence: what is the control that stops a hijacked agent from doing damage, and where does it live?
delayed_quiz.a: A deterministic allowlist or write gate on the tool or the server (RBAC verbs, MCP read-only flags, the ssh-tool regex), not the model.

delayed_quiz.q: Why does the Lab 6 audit count come from the API server and not from HolmesGPT's own output?
delayed_quiz.a: Agents misreport what they did. Independent monitoring cross-checks the agent's claims against system logs.

delayed_quiz.q: Name the two things run.sh validate proves before any timing counts.
delayed_quiz.a: A no-op fails the hidden tests; the oracle solution passes them.

delayed_quiz.q: What does cgroup2fs tell you, and why does it matter for every lab here?
delayed_quiz.a: The host runs the unified cgroup v2 hierarchy, which current systemd, Kubernetes kubelet and the MemoryHigh/MemoryMax limits in these labs depend on.

delayed_quiz.q: Which file in your sandbox config would have stopped an agent from finding a broadly scoped token in an unrelated file, and what line?
delayed_quiz.a: A denyRead on credential paths and token files (for example **/*token*, **/.env, ~/.ssh) in the sandbox settings.
